purpose: First-party facts from Brother's product page, limited warranty and handbook, compared against data/specs/brother-1034d.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

documents.note: Specs table, in-the-box list, price, accessory feet

documents.type: Handbook for Compact Overlock Machine, 68 pages, EN/ES, form 884-345
documents.note: Image-only PDF, read by OCR. A family handbook: it covers one-needle and two-needle models and never names the 1034D, so values for the family may not match this model

facts.value: Product page 13.45 lb; handbook 7.0 kg (15.4 lb)
facts.note: Spec has 13.88 lb (a dealer) flagged verify. Brother's page says 13.45 lb. The handbook says 7.0 kg net, which is 15.4 lb, but it is a family handbook. Use the Brother page.

site.label: Weight
site.juki: Product page: 13.45 lb. The family handbook says 7.0 kg (15.4 lb).
site.others: Dealers and blogs quote 13.5 to 13.88 lb; two blogs say about 15 and 16 lb.

facts.note: Page gives three machine dimensions; width, depth and height order not labelled.

facts.value: 3 or 4 thread, two needles. '2/3/4 thread change: No' (no 2-thread stitch)
facts.source: brother-page Features and Specifications; brother-handbook p.59 ('Three/Four threads convertible')

site.label: Thread counts
site.juki: 3 or 4 thread, two needles. Brother lists 2/3/4 thread change as No, so no 2-thread stitches.
site.others: Juki MO-654DE comparisons say it adds 2-thread stitches.

facts.value: Page feature: 3.00 to 7.00 mm. Page spec: overlock seam width 5.0 to 7.0 mm. Handbook: 2.3 to 7 mm (two-needle), 3.0 to 3.5 mm (one-needle)
facts.note: Three Brother figures. The 3.0 to 3.5 mm range is for one-needle models in the handbook, so the page's 3.00 to 7.00 mm may merge both families.

site.label: Stitch width
site.juki: Brother's page gives 3.0 to 7.0 mm in one place and 5.0 to 7.0 mm in another. The family handbook says 2.3 to 7 mm for two-needle models.

facts.value: Bulb (page); replace with 15 W bulb (handbook p.2)
facts.note: Not LED. A buyer wanting LED should compare the 1034DX; check that page before claiming it.

facts.value: Standard foot, blindstitch foot, gathering foot. In the box: 4 large spools of serger thread, soft cover, needle set, thread nets, spool caps, tweezers, cleaning brush, hex driver, trim trap, foot controller, manual
facts.source: brother-page Specifications and In the Box

site.label: Feet and box contents
site.juki: Standard, blindstitch and gathering feet, plus 4 spools, soft cover, tweezers, brush, hex driver and trim trap.
site.others: Dealers list the same three feet.

facts.value: 1 year parts, labor and accessories; 5 years electronic components and circuit boards (replacement labor excluded); 25 years chassis casting. Original end-user only; machines from non-authorized sellers or used or refurbished by others may not be covered
facts.note: The 25 years covers only the chassis casting. The spec and many blogs say 25-year warranty without this limit.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: 1 year parts and labor, 5 years electronics (labor excluded), 25 years chassis casting only. Original buyer from an authorized seller.
site.others: Dealers and blogs say '25-year limited warranty'.

facts.value: Oil once or twice a month for normal use, once a week if used more often; clean lint first

site.label: Oiling
site.juki: Once or twice a month for normal use, weekly for heavier use, after cleaning lint.
site.others: Only a few owners mention oiling at all; those who do treat it as routine upkeep.

facts.value: USD 319.99 new on brother-usa.com 2026-10-01; 1034DX listed at 289.99; refurbished option offered
facts.note: At Brother USA the 1034DX is listed below the 1034D, the reverse of the usual 'DX costs more' claim.

site.label: Price
site.juki: $319.99 new at Brother USA on 2026-10-01. The 1034DX is $289.99 there.
site.others: Sewing Machines Plus snippets showed bundles from $249.99 to $579.99.
